description: This file defines a React component named 'Logo' that renders a logo image with fallback sources, responsive styling, and error handling. It manages public asset paths, accepts customizable props for image source, size, and styling, and includes inline CSS styling.

methods.name: Logo
methods.description: React functional component that renders a logo image with fallback mechanisms and styling.
parameters: src: optional string - explicit image URL
alt: string - alternative text for the image
width: number or string - width of the image
height: number or string - height of the image
size: number - default size (fallback for width)
